concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-in-person-guides-paypal-and-venmo-qrc]] - 2026-09-16 unversioned Braintree website guide for a limited-release, approval-gated merchant-presented PayPal/Venmo QR Code option on Braintree In-Person readers, with account/location and sandbox-test setup, no-vault and refund boundaries; not current support, SDK/GitHub authority, merchant enablement, or payment, settlement or funding proof
warnings: Keep the guide's reader, account, environment and limited-release approval scope; do not generalize it to online Venmo/PayPal checkout or current production support.
